focus.leftTitle: Cau hoi nguoi mua thuong gap
leftItems: Ngan nuoc co kin khong?
Co — chau trong va ngoai khop chat. Khong ro ri tren mat phang. Co khay hung kem de bao ve ke.
Nuoc dung duoc bao lau?
Thuong 7-14 ngay cho cay nhiet doi pho bien. Tuy loai cay va khi hau.
Lam mau rieng duoc khong?
Duoc, MOQ 200 cai moi mau rieng, them 30 ngay cho mau khuon moi.
PP co an toan thuc pham?
Nhua PP cua chung toi khong BPA. Phu hop trong rau thom va cay an duoc.

Co bao bi hop qua san sang ban le cho don giao truc tiep Shopee/Lazada.
COO (Form E), phieu dong goi va hoa don thuong mai kem theo tieu chuan.

Co ca hai. Luoi/duc lo = air pruning. Kin = vuon uom tieu chuan. Cung size gallon cho ca hai kieu.

Tron size trong mot don duoc khong?

Co Form E RCEP khong?
Co — chung toi la don vi phat hanh Form E RCEP. Giam thue nhap ve 0-5% cho Viet Nam va Indonesia.

leftItems: PET hay PS?
PET cung hon va trong hon; PS re hon. Trong lan nen dung PET. Coc uom (dung mot lan) thi PS du tot.
Khe co lam yeu chau?
Khong — vien khe gia cuong giu do cung. Da thu nghiem den 2 kg cay + gia the.
In logo len chau trong duoc khong?
Duoc — in lua hoac nhan co. MOQ 500 cai cho in lua.
Co chau ngoai trang tri kem khong?
Co — chung toi cung cap chau ngoai duc mau dong bo de dat chau trong ben trong.

focus.leftTitle: Cau hoi nguoi mua thuong gap
leftItems: Lam mau doc quyen duoc khong?
Duoc — khuon OEM doc quyen tu MOQ 500 cai/mau. Phi khuon bao rieng.
Co chong nuoc khong?
Resin va MGO chiu nuoc. Moi mau deu co lo thoat nuoc tieu chuan. Khong phu hop ngap nuoc ngoai troi keo dai.
Chong vo khi van chuyen the nao?
Hop qua rieng + xop lot + lop bong khi thung ngoai. Ty le vo duoi 1% van chuyen tieu chuan.
Co mau moi theo mua?
Chung toi ra 10-15 mau moi moi quy. Khach WhatsApp nhan catalogue som nhat.
focus.rightTitle: Ghi chu cuoc van va xuat khau
rightItems: Mau resin: nhe (150-400 g moi cai) — bay duoc cho don thu nghiem nho.
Mau MGO xi mang: nang hon — nen di bien FCL cho don tren 500 cai.
HS 6913.90 (gia gom) hoac 3926.90 (resin) — xac nhan voi khai quan theo tung mau.
FOB Yiwu hoac FOB Shenzhen tuy phan bo nha may — bao gia ghi ro cang.
